rows: The Invitation Received by Team Orbit

At 3:58 PM, Meera saved a photograph of the invitation delivered to her team. It says: “Final Prototype Reveal — check-in 4:30 PM.” The QR code reads ORB-041. The paper is ordinary event stock. The photograph timestamp is from Meera’s phone; it proves what she received, not who printed it.

The signed master run sheet lists Team Orbit check-in at 4:00 PM and Team Nova check-in at 4:10 PM. A 3:42 PM revision moved the opening remarks by five minutes but did not change either team’s check-in time. The file history attributes that revision to Rohan Mehta.

At 4:02 PM, the desk marked Team Orbit “not present.” At 4:12 PM, Meera arrived and showed the invitation with the 4:30 PM time. The desk paused Orbit’s check-in rather than disqualifying the team. A handwritten note says, “QR accepted, time conflicts with master.”

Aanya handled invitation delivery and registration materials from 3:30–4:15 PM. Irfan operated the print desk from 3:35–4:05 PM. Rohan worked at the schedule desk. Kabir carried sealed envelopes between desks. Sana photographed the registration area. Several people could approach the printer; this board alone does not identify who printed any particular page.
